elkdtmqy3evr1.name: User
elkdtmqy3evr1.doc: role: NON_MUSLIM | NEW_MUSLIM | DIALOGIST | ISLAMIC_INSTRUCTOR | SUPERVISOR | ADMINISTRATOR. Staff accounts (supervisor, dialogist, instructor, administrator) are created by an administrator.

ops.params: role: str, name: str, email: str

ops.name: uploadIslamicResource
ops.params: title: str, resourceType: str, fileUrl: str

ops.name: updateProfile
ops.params: nationality: str, gender: str, phone: str

ellpgzuo7evr1.name: Conversation
ellpgzuo7evr1.doc: A conversation is never closed: the user (Non-Muslim or New Muslim) can come back to it at any time. status: UNASSIGNED | ASSIGNED. A conversation is assigned to only one dialogist.

el3aem1qxevr1.name: PredefinedMessage
el3aem1qxevr1.doc: Created by a dialogist (committee of dialogists), approved by a supervisor. Before approval only the author can use it; once approved it is available to ALL dialogists, including new accounts.

elmdrp0elevr2.name: Shahadah
elmdrp0elevr2.doc: validationStatus: PENDING | VALIDATED | REJECTED. Validate / Reject buttons are shown to the dialogist under the voice note.

elazqcc69evr6.name: Once Shahadah pronunciation is validated, congratulation is sent and profile update converts account to NewMuslim.

elij9hyywevr7.name: Minimum 80% score is required to pass each 20-question quiz and the 100-question final exam (unlimited attempts).

elbxxqjz9evr9.name: IslamicResource
elbxxqjz9evr9.doc: Videos, audios, images and documents uploaded by an administrator. Any visitor can access them without an account.

el23ygs3vevr9.name: Conversion keeps the SAME account (same userId): after a validated Shahadah and the profile update, a NonMuslim becomes a NewMuslim. The conversation and its messages are kept.

elvf6ibfnevr9.name: A conversation is never closed. It stays available to the user after conversion. status: UNASSIGNED | ASSIGNED. Only one dialogist per conversation.

elfxuru1kevr9.name: Predefined messages: created by a dialogist (with a shortcut) and approved by a supervisor. Before approval only the author can use them; once approved they are available to ALL dialogists, including new accounts.

el2dhgmmcevr9.name: Validate / Reject buttons appear under the voice note in the conversation. validationStatus: PENDING | VALIDATED | REJECTED. Only the dialogist assigned to the conversation can validate or reject. After a rejection the user sends a new voice note (new Shahadah).

el65us60qevr9.name: The supervisor supervises dialogists and Islamic instructors (superviseStaff). Staff accounts are created only by an administrator.

elqxqsxlaevr9.name: Complete profile and become New Muslim

elj9fd8qwevr9.name: Reject Shahadah and request new voice note

elkg2i33fevr9.name: Every staff role inherits from User, so it also has Log in, Reset password and Manage profile (see the diagram "Visitors and users").

ell79ccffevr9.name: If no dialogist replies within 2 minutes, Conversation.sendAutoReply sends an automatic message (no specialist available). The conversation stays UNASSIGNED and open until a dialogist accepts it.

elonqjmxpevr9.name: acceptConversation assigns the conversation to the first dialogist only; if it is already ASSIGNED it returns false. A quick reply must be based on an approved PredefinedMessage (or one created by this dialogist). The conversation is never closed: a New Muslim reuses it later (openConversation).
